eventDetail.scope: Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security, Intelligent Computing, Communication Systems, and Computer Networks. The conference provides a multidisciplinary platform for researchers, academicians, industry professionals, and practitioners to present and discuss theoretical developments, practical applications, and emerging technologies in intelligent and secure digital ecosystems.  The scope includes, but is not limited to, machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, cyber-physical systems, intelligent systems, soft computing, cloud and edge computing, Internet of Things (IoT), blockchain, digital twins, network and information security, data analytics, communication technologies, 6G networks, autonomous systems, smart cities, smart healthcare, and system-of-systems engineering. The conference encourages innovative research that addresses the challenges of digital transformation, intelligent automation, secure communications, and resilient computing infrastructures.
